A.name: Stack A: AI Browser Sandbox, CDP Fleet & Structured Extraction
A.tagline: Browserless & Steel provide isolated Chromium CDP sandboxes for Browser-Use agents, Crawl4AI extracts clean LLM Markdown/JSON, ChangeDetection triggers on portal updates.

B.name: Stack B: Live noVNC Portal RPA, Script Runner & ERP Sync
B.tagline: Selenium Standalone exposes live noVNC for 2FA handoffs, Windmill executes Python/TS RPA scripts at scale, Activepieces & n8n sync portal data into your CRM/ERP.

browserless-chrome.name: Browserless Chromium CDP
browserless-chrome.role: Headless Chromium fleet with Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) & live Debugger UI
browserless-chrome.first_run: Connect Browser-Use or Playwright directly to ws://localhost:7100?token=<TOKEN> for isolated runs.

crawl4ai.name: Crawl4AI Extractor
crawl4ai.role: LLM-ready headless web crawler outputting clean Markdown & structured JSON schemas
crawl4ai.first_run: Open /playground to test zero-API extraction or POST URLs to /crawl from n8n.

steel-browser.name: Steel AI Browser Sandbox
steel-browser.role: Stateful AI agent browser with persistent profiles, cookies & live session viewer
steel-browser.first_run: Watch AI browser sessions live at /ui and attach Browser-Use via ws://localhost:7120.

changedetection.name: ChangeDetection Monitor
changedetection.role: 24/7 portal, pricing & regulatory page monitor with visual diffs & webhook alerts
changedetection.first_run: Add any vendor/competitor URL and fire an n8n webhook automatically whenever a value changes.

selenium-grid.name: Selenium + Live noVNC
selenium-grid.role: Interactive Chromium RPA runner with live browser desktop stream for human 2FA handoff
selenium-grid.first_run: Grid UI on :7200 and live interactive noVNC desktop on http://localhost:7201 (password: secret).

windmill-rpa.name: Windmill RPA Runner
windmill-rpa.role: High-speed Python & TypeScript RPA script scheduler with audit logs & approval flows
windmill-rpa.first_run: Default local login: admin@windmill.dev / changeme. Paste compiled Browser-Use scripts to schedule.

activepieces-rpa.name: Activepieces RPA Glue
activepieces-rpa.role: MIT-licensed no-code automation builder for syncing scraped portal data into CRMs
activepieces-rpa.first_run: Create your local workspace to connect portal extraction webhooks to Slack, Sheets, or Twenty CRM.

n8n-rpa.name: n8n Portal Orchestrator
n8n-rpa.role: End-to-end RPA workflow scheduler wiring Crawl4AI, ChangeDetection & ERP webhooks
n8n-rpa.first_run: Import /automations/stack_a_portal_extract_sync.n8n.json to run scheduled zero-API portal syncs.
